branch_identity: Classic two-tab alternative. v2.14 fixes the display-only Legacy Deck Library by reusing Main-Deck-style full card tiles with flex wrapping, preventing stacked/overlapping cards and horizontal scrolling; Style 1 v3.13 remains the primary Deck Builder line.
main_deck_sort: Skill, Event, Item; Card ID ascending within each family
theme_reference: Public Deck Builder v3.12 dark gray, gold, cyan, Card Review hierarchy, and exact Deck Builder tagline
legacy_deck_layout: One-page desktop split with enlarged matching gray Hero/Legacy frames, position labels below Hero cards, centered SVG swap controls, and frame-aligned Rank/Legacy controls
filter_layout: Top row unchanged; lower row keeps Mana Cost first with compact range allocation, then All Cards, Available Cards, and complete Reset button
card_review: v3.12-aligned metrics and hierarchy with Hero-only right-detail scrolling
mobile_status: responsive fallback included; desktop is the locked target
legacy_reference_library: Display-only responsive Legacy Deck Library. Button sits beside the 0/12 Legacy Deck total; Hero cards are shown first and Legacy cards after. Cards use full Main-Deck-style tiles with normal size, no overlap, no horizontal scrolling, no search/filter/dimming/add/select behavior, and Card Review remains available.
release_delta: UI-only. Legacy Deck Library now uses fixed full-card flex tiles instead of the previous stacked grid, so every Hero and Legacy card appears as a complete card like the Main Deck view. Deck format, card definitions, starter data, Legacy selection rules, and gameplay behavior unchanged.
